summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin providing engineering and productivity workflow skills for planning, implementation, code review, testing, debugging, documentation, collaboration, and guided learning.

capabilities: Provides 25 engineering and productivity workflow skills for planning, implementation, review, testing, debugging, research, documentation, and handoffs.
Can create or update local project artifacts such as teaching workspaces, reports, guides, tickets, and configuration files.
Includes setup guidance for issue-tracker providers, triage labels, and project domain context.
May use bundled local scripts referenced by individual skills.
